title: Ratio tiles with no clocked hours show an empty chart outline
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).
  2. You use a desktop browser window at least 1024 pixels wide (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  3. You are in a location (workplace) with nothing in it: no work order, invoice, credit or clocked time (for example ZZAUTOTEST Empty Shop).

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 3: profile icon > Settings > Locations > New Location: Name ZZAUTOTEST Empty Shop, the address fields, Timezone, Telephone, Shop Supplies Charge 0 % > Save & Close (if a location with this name already exists, reuse it only if it still matches the precondition). It then appears in your Change Location list; to switch to it, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. Create nothing in it.
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top menu with ZZAUTOTEST Empty Shop selected and every tile on This Month.
  2. Look at the area under the supporting line on Billing Efficiency, Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization.
  3. Read each of the three tiles' headline and supporting line.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Each of the three tiles shows a dashed outline with a small line-chart icon in its middle, sitting where the trend line would be. No trend line is drawn and the space is not left blank.
  • The headline and supporting line still show their usual values for a range with no hours: the grey "-" headline, and "0.00 Invoiced / 0.00 Clocked", "0.00 Invoiced Tech Hrs / 0.00 Clocked" and "0.00 WO Hrs / 0.00 Clocked".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9576 (Story 4, KPI Hero Tiles); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 4. Design canvas board 15_Empty_Design (row 15, approved 7 Oct 2026; today's build is board 15_Empty_Now).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R12: “A tile shows the empty-chart placeholder in place of its sparkline when fewer than two points in the selected range have a value.”
  • S4-R18: “The placeholder changes nothing else on the tile. The headline and the supporting line show their usual values.”
